```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity Value'>">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block covering multiple namespaces and entities -->
  <sub:child sub:id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unescaped markup: <root>&ent;</root>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY ext "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_macro "<!ELEMENT macro_elem (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd_macro;
]>
<?pi-target data="processing instruction content with &base;"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- First comment -->
  <ns:section>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entity reference simulation &ext;
    ]]>
  </ns:section>
  <!-- Second comment -->
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block.
    ]]>
    &ext;
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Value2">
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext_pe;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment detailing namespace abuse and entity nesting -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like string inside CDATA -->
      <html:div>HTML fragment inside CDATA with &ent2;</html:div>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <html:p>&ent2;</html:p>
</catalog>
```

<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % inner "CDATA">
  <!ENTITY ent "Standard Entity">
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="test"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/meta" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Metadata and CDATA stress test comment -->
  <meta:record xsi:type="meta:stringType">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw text with special characters: <tag> &ent; </tag>
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
  <record>
    <?meta-pi action="process"?>
    &ent;
  </record>
</archive>
```

<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task+)>

  <!ENTITY e1 "TaskOne">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; & TaskTwo">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY documentation SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<project xmlns="http://example.org/project" xmlns:p="http://example.org/project/params">
  <!-- Multi-purpose comment block before complex nodes -->
  <p:task p:priority="high">
    <![CDATA[
      <?xml-processing instruction inside CDATA ?>
      <!DOCTYPE internal-spoiler [<!ENTITY hack "fail">]>
      Content with &e2;
    ]]>
  </p:task>
  <task>&e2;</task>
</project>
